title: Boiling-water canning for tested acid foods
subcategory: Boiling-water canning for tested acid foods
summary: Use boiling-water processing only for products covered by a current tested acid-food recipe.
steps: Confirm the recipe is current, tested and specifically intended for boiling-water canning.
Use the stated ingredient proportions, jar type, headspace and preparation; do not add extra low-acid vegetables.
Process for the full stated time, adjusting for altitude exactly as directed.
Cool undisturbed, verify the seal by the approved method and label the date.
Refrigerate and use promptly any jar that fails to seal only when the tested instructions permit; otherwise discard safely.
